speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you have a 2-day history of fever and altered mentation; to begin my evaluation, have you experienced any severe headache, neck stiffness, or a rash?

speaker: Patient
text: 22-year-old male. The patient presents with a 2-day history of fever and altered mentation, reporting fever without chills and rigors. He denies sore throat, abdominal pain, headache, loose stool, burning micturition, or seizures. Has a history of tics and is currently taking haloperidol.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Neuroleptic Malignant Syndrome (NMS)
The presence of fever, altered mentation, and a history of taking haloperidol for tics strongly suggests NMS. I have ruled out meningitis and encephalitis due to the absence of headache, neck stiffness, and seizure activity.
